results.title: OneXPlayer X2 Mini Pro handheld console with SteamOS tested in AAA games
results.description: YouTuber ETA Prime has put Steam OS on the AMD Strix Halo-powered OneXPlayer X2 Mini Pro handheld gaming console and tested it in AAA games. The console proved to be an impressive gaming handheld, playing demanding titles like Crimson Desert at over 60 FPS.

results.title: TD Waterhouse Canada Inc. Purchases 19,088 Shares of Johnson Controls International plc $JCI
results.description: TD Waterhouse Canada Inc. boosted its holdings in Johnson Controls International plc (NYSE:JCI – Free Report) by 18.0% in the 2nd quarter, according to the company in its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The firm owned 124,880 shares of the company’s stock after purchasing an additional 19,088 shares during the quarter. [...]
